Privacy policy

This policy explains what personal data Shree Siddhivinayak Classes (“SSV”, “we”) collects through this website and the SSV app, why, and what you can do about it.

Privacy policyTerms of useRefund policyDelivery policy

This website

The website has no accounts, no advertising and no analytics trackers. The contact form does not send anything to us by itself: it opens your own email app with the message ready to send. Our hosting provider keeps standard server logs (such as IP address and browser type) for security. The intro film is a YouTube video in privacy-enhanced mode, and loads only when you press play.

Information the app collects

When you sign up and use the SSV app, we collect:

  • Personal details: name, email, mobile number and Student ID
  • Sign-in details: your password, stored securely
  • Study details: standard, state, district and any SSV class code
  • Usage: courses you open, your progress, downloads and purchases

Signing in with Google

If you sign in with Google, Google shares your name, email address and profile photo with us. We use these only to create and run your account. We never receive your Google password.

How we use it

  • To provide your lessons and notes
  • To process payments and manage course access
  • To track your progress and show it to you
  • To tell you about new courses and updates
  • To answer your questions and give support

Where it is stored

Account and study data is stored with Supabase on servers in Mumbai, India. We use appropriate security measures, but no way of sending or storing data over the internet is completely secure.

Payments

Payments are processed by Razorpay. Card, UPI and bank details go directly to Razorpay; we never see or store them. We keep a record of what you bought so we can unlock it for you.

Sharing

We do not sell, trade or rent personal data. It is used only:

  • To provide the app and its lessons
  • By authorised SSV staff for administration
  • By the services that run the app for us: Supabase (storage), Razorpay (payments) and Google (sign-in)
  • When the law requires it

Your rights

  • See and update your details from your profile in the app
  • Delete your account from Profile → Delete account, which removes your personal data
  • Opt out of messages from us
  • Ask us about your data at contact@siddhivinayakclasses.org

Students under 18

The app is made for students in Standards 11 and 12. We take special care with the data of minors and follow the privacy laws that apply in India.

Changes

If we change this policy, we will post the new version here and update the date above.

Contact

Email contact@siddhivinayakclasses.org. We reply on working days.

Shree Siddhivinayak Classes

Physics, Chemistry and Maths for Standards 11 and 12. GSEB boards, GUJCET and NEET. The SSV app is coming soon to Android and iPhone.
